statement: The closest existing work, arxiv:2609.12230, overlaps the idea at the level of problem, method and evaluation: it proposes exactly the same context-augmented vs KG-grounded supervision comparison, adds the same LLM-judged one-hop repair loop, applies lower-hop RL, and evaluates 3-5-hop transfer (see C002, C003). The only remaining differences are evaluation rigor and scope (matched-token/matched-example controls, an untouched held-out evaluation set, standard-benchmark generalization, seed-level significance), not mechanism.

evidence.quote: We propose a context-augmented KG supervision framework that attaches supporting triples from the same source text chunk to each primary KG triple, producing CG-grounded supervision alongside standard KG-grounded supervision.
